lines.say: replaces missing testosterone when they fail or aren't signaled properly
LH and FSH fall, the signals that drive the testes
sexual activity, desire and erections rose modestly in men 65+ with low testosterone
mood lifted slightly, but vitality and walking distance didn't (men 65+, a year)
about 1.6 kg more lean mass and 1.6 kg less fat in middle-aged and older men
desire, arousal and orgasm rose in postmenopausal women with low desire (off-label)
hematocrit can rise, which thickens the blood; lipids are checked too
PSA can rise (11.1% vs 0% on placebo in a gel trial); an enlarged prostate can worsen
gel on the skin can pass to children and masculinize them (boxed warning)
blood pressure rises with all testosterone products, FDA says; it's checked
lower sperm production and possible infertility
major heart events no likelier than placebo in 5,246 men, but atrial fibrillation rose

ask: How often will you check my hematocrit, PSA and blood pressure?
